summary: Plan school risk assessments, DRR lessons and preparedness drills. Explore this five-day education resilience course.
lede: Disaster resilience education connects school and community risks with preparedness learning and safer, more continuous education. It is for education practitioners, teacher trainers, curriculum specialists and school safety coordinators who need to make preparedness actionable. Participants practise multi-hazard school risk assessment, map disaster-risk content into lessons, and plan teacher-training activities and drills using the Comprehensive School Safety Framework 2022–2030 as a guide.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is designed for professionals who develop, deliver or coordinate disaster risk reduction learning and preparedness across schools and education communities.
prerequisites: Prior experience developing, delivering or coordinating education activities is recommended. Familiarity with school preparedness or disaster risk reduction is useful. No coding or programming is required; digital comprehensive school safety assessment toolsets are introduced at an operational planning level and depend on local access.
